request: Build a spreadsheet app in a single HTML file. It renders a grid of cells with column letters and row numbers, formulas entered with an = prefix (arithmetic plus SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX over cell ranges like A1:B5), cell references like B2 that recalculate, live error reporting including circular references, an edit formula bar, arrow and tab key navigation between cells, save to localStorage and clear, while every formula result updates when referenced cells change.

intent.goal: build a spreadsheet app in a single html file.

planFiles.summary: Spreadsheet HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
